c1_whitelist_note: per-corpus: derive from the relation census of the first batch (playbook Part B #6); setup does not invent it
role_word_rules_from_profile: Role nouns such as Company, Consultant, Employer, Executive, Service Provider, Service Recipient, Party, Parties, Party A/B, and Affiliate are not identities and must be resolved to their defining named entities within each document.
proposer_framing: Extract factual relations from this commercial contract excerpt.
slot_framing: You extract clause facts from a commercial contract excerpt.
slot_rules:
- "value": the shortest complete value. For Governing Law, the
  jurisdiction only (e.g. "Delaware"). For dates, as written. For
  Cap On Liability, the cap amount or formula as written. For
  yes/no-style categories (Uncapped Liability, Exclusivity,
  Non-Compete, Anti-Assignment, Change Of Control, Minimum
  Commitment, Termination For Convenience, License Grant,
  Irrevocable Or Perpetual License), value is "Yes" when the clause
  is present.
- "quote": copy the EXACT verbatim text from the excerpt that states
  the fact (a phrase or one sentence). It must match the excerpt
  character-for-character. Never paraphrase the quote.
- Parties: one entry per party, value = the party's legal name.
framing_note: PK-01 (2026-10-19): this family's domain framing for the proposer base prompts, carried as profile data (pilot/profile_config.py). The core templates are domain-neutral; these declared values reproduce the pre-PK-01 CUAD prompts byte-for-byte (scripts/test_domain_boundary.py).
